items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: the house band consisted of Omar Harkim, Marcus Miller, Phillipe Saisse, Hiram Bullock ... and David, and yeah I did part of the first season

ctx.x: Was that — that was not live was it?

No it was recorded but there was a big cross pollination between that and Saturday Night Live at the time. A lot of people from that show worked there. My boss, my late boss at SNL, Stacey Foster, had hired me to do “Night Music” when effectively he had no business doing so. Because I hadn’t had a lot of live experience other than doing a live record with the flutist Dave Valentin at the Blue Note a few months before. It’s like well okay I guess I’ve done something live now. But they were putting the show…

and David, and yeah I did part of the first season based upon my work at GRP I was brought in. That’s how I was hired. And that was the transition when I went freelance away from GRP and started working out freelance, even though I continued to do a bunch of work for GRP for about a year. It was as though I never left, I just wasn’t a full time employee there. And keeping in touch with the people from “Night Music” is how I ultimately got the call for SNL. And I spent the first three years at SNL doing audiotape…
